name: No-Scope Sniping
desc:
👉 No-Scope Sniping is an intense skill-based shooter based on no-scoping! Compete, win, and use your earned money to unlock cool new skins and characters to play with from a wide variety of cases. Be sure to play with your friends to have more fun!

😱 You're getting better at FPS games! Keep your practice up and really hone your skill across all other shooters.

💡 Enter the menu at any time by pressing 'm'.

⭐ Did you like NSS? You may really like No-Scope Arcade! 
https://www.roblox.com/games/6407649031

👍 A like and favorite is considerate and greatly appreciated by the developers!
